search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches found the exact secondary-source assertion and dated issuer evidence for historical Bosch engagement and Visteon's 2022 supplier award. The missing article date, major-customer basis, and ranking methodology remain unresolved.
The Yahoo Finance page reproduces a 財訊快報-attributed article excerpt naming the six firms, but the retrieved page did not expose its publication date or an underlying ranking source.
The phrase “全球前20大汽車電子系統大廠” has no identified ranking period, category definition, or denominator in the retrieved evidence.
Issuer evidence for Bosch and Visteon establishes historical commercial/supplier relationships only; it does not establish major-customer status.
